summary:
Plan of w169 (spec-integration#r43) written.
No accepted scenarios: spec-integration is group guarantees (decision 0065), and work_items.py passes a guarantees-only work-item with no test.
D1: supervision#r102 (w170) has work run give the ids in the brief, so w169 changes only what the round, writer, skill and doc do with given ids. Researcher's reading (a).
supervise_brief.py, the integrate steps and supervision.feature are dropped from the file set: they are w170's, and editing them in both would collide at merge.
D2: added ids go above used, retired and given ids on the same capability (r12, r43). D3: the round checks its adds against the given ids (r43). D4: with no ids given, r12 numbering as today.
Tests broken: none (no test asserts the brief's or the agent texts' wording, per the notes' search).
Open cases: the label for the given ids (must match w170's), a given id already in spec/, term ids, rounds from 2 on.
